name: Enterprise Group Landscape and Scope View
constraints: Group Landscape is a governed profile declaration and never creates a business-object identity.
Group Scope View is an immutable digest-identified generated projection and cannot be re-imported as source truth.
WM-ORG-001 masters organization subjects and WM-ORG-012 masters purpose-qualified relationship assertions.
Legal ownership, accounting consolidation, management, operations, brand and franchise participation remain parallel graph kinds.
No boundary is inferred from another; ownership does not imply consolidation or access and brand does not imply control.
Every boundary kind pins its definition version, purpose, jurisdiction, graph rules, evidence threshold and disclosure class.
Unknown, not applicable, suppressed and pending are distinct typed states.
Disputed and competing claims coexist with claimant capacity, evidence and resolution authority.
Each released view pins world time, knowledge time, scenario, roots, depth, input revisions and graph-rule version.
Hypothetical facts never mix with authoritative facts.
Federated output preserves master, steward, asserting party, claimant capacity and evidence for every edge.
Derived and asserted edges remain visibly distinct and retain derivation inputs and rule version.
Group membership never grants authority or access; disclosure requires a valid WM-XCT-002 grant and WM-XCT-003 shape.
Graph rules apply per boundary kind and interval rather than to the graph union.
A statutory group uses WM-ORG-001 identity only when it independently bears standing, obligations, statements or succession.
A Group Scope View digest binds landscape revision, world time, knowledge time, scenario, graph rules, source revisions, grant set, disclosure shape and generated projection.
Identical pins and projection yield the identical digest; any pin or projection change yields a new immutable digest.
Each cross-organization fact in a view requires an authorized WM-XCT-002 grant and a WM-XCT-003 disclosure shape; neither is stored on the view.
Typed unknown, disputed and unverified states may be excluded only by pinned graph rules or disclosure shape, and the exclusion remains visible in the pins.
A profile name is an operator label, never a surrogate organization, party, ledger or contract key.
A named pre-incorporation body with independent party or standing capacity is instantiated as WM-ORG-001; naming convenience alone never promotes a landscape.

Landscape revision handles and Scope View digests are non-registrable artifact identifiers; business objects may cite them as evidence but cannot use them as identity-bearing foreign keys, parties, accounts or contract subjects.
The Landscape profile revision masters graph and uncertainty-propagation rules; WM-XCT-040 masters the immutable composition pin package used to bind those rules and inputs.
The Scope View digest additionally binds the composition rule and engine revision so the complete pin set deterministically reproduces the projection.
Grant-set and disclosure-shape pins resolve to immutable revisions retained for independent verification; revocation changes current entitlement but never mutates or erases a prior revision.
Every emitted cross-organization fact, including a membership edge, requires an authorized disclosure basis and governed shape; public-source disclosure uses an explicit policy/grant basis.
holds: WM-ORG-001 and WM-ORG-012 remain non-canonical reviewable drafts.
WM-ORG-012 registry parent assignment conflicts with its specification reference boundary.
Relationship and graph fixtures are incomplete.
Franchise, security-trust, trademark and external-source boundaries remain incomplete.
Pairwise export loses some multi-party relationship context.
Publication requires canonical enforcement of non-registrable artifact identifiers, immutable grant/shape revision retention and composition-engine pinning.
